item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 10/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong moderating gradually, temperatures will rise over the region today and tomorrow. There will be sunny periods. Under the influence of a maritime airstream, it will be warm and humid with fog over the coastal areas midweek this week. A band of clouds will bring showers to inland Guangdong in the latter part of this week. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Saturday. It will become cool over the region early next week. The weather will improve. It will be dry during the day.
